name: The Indian Link Chain Manufactures Limited
about: The Indian Link Chain Manufactures Limited engages in the trading of agricultural goods in India. It trades in crops, grains, pulses, spices, dry fruits, and other edible products. It also engages in plantation and production of organic food products, fruits, vegetables, dairy, forestry, agricultural, horticulture, tea, coffee, rubber, mineral, cotton, silk, cereals, cotton - silk, vetiveria, wood, lac culture, timber, fuel, floriculture, bee keeping, fodder raising, and seeding, as well as manufacturing, trading, and processing of agriculture products and allied activities. The Indian Link Chain Manufactures Limited was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Mumbai, India.
